Roster: FIFO or Residential Options Available
Location: Pilbara WA
Employment Type: Casual with ongoing opportunities

Cat5 Rail is seeking a Mechanical or Electrical Technician to maintain specialised rail maintenance equipment across major Pilbara rail networks.
Working on advanced mobile flashbutt welding machines and rail maintenance assets, you will be responsible for fault finding, preventative maintenance, breakdown repairs and equipment reliability across critical rail infrastructure operations.
This role would suit HD Fitters, LV Mechanics, Auto Electricians, Field Service Technicians or Rail Maintenance Technicians looking to transition into specialised rail equipment.
 
Key Responsibilities:

• Maintain and repair flashbutt welding equipment
• Diagnose mechanical, electrical, hydraulic and PLC faults
• Provide breakdown support and troubleshooting
• Complete preventative maintenance and servicing
• Read electrical and hydraulic schematics
• Assist with equipment commissioning and calibration
• Complete maintenance reports and documentation
• Support safe rail maintenance operations
• Maintain strong safety and housekeeping standards

Role Requirements:

• Australian recognised Mechanical or Electrical trade qualification
• Full Australian working rights 
• Experience with flashbutt welders or heavy mobile equipment
• Strong mechanical and electrical fault-finding skills
• Experience with hydraulic and control systems
• Allen Bradley PLC diagnostics experience
• Ability to read schematics and wiring diagrams
• Current unrestricted Australian Driver’s Licence - Heavy Rigid Licence
• Construction Induction Card
• High Risk Work Licence - LF, DG, C2 or similar
• Advanced First Aid
• Ability to pass CAT 1 Rail Medical and Drug & Alcohol screening

Desirable Experience:

• Previous rail industry experience
• Experience with mobile flashbutt welding equipment including DOOSAN          systems highly regarded
• Cert IV Instrumentation highly regarded
• Cert II or III in Rail Infrastructure
• TLIC3045 Operate Road/Rail Vehicle
• 4WD Training 

 What we can offer you:
• People-focused team culture with strong safety values
• Training and mentoring on flashbutt welding and specialist rail equipment
• Work with advanced rail machinery and technology
• Competitive pay and favourable working conditions
• Ongoing training and nationally recognised certifications
• Exposure to major rail projects and Tier 1 rail networks


How to Apply:
Click APPLY now and ensure your resume is up to date with relevant rail, mechanical, electrical and fault-finding experience. Shortlisted candidates will be contacted promptly for a confidential discussion.

About Us:
Cat5 Rail is a family-owned business operating across Australia and New Zealand. Over the past 3 years, we have built one of the largest privately owned fleets of specialised rail equipment in the country, supported by maintenance facilities in Karratha, Port Hedland and Perth.
From metro networks to remote regional operations, Cat5 Rail delivers safe, reliable and sustainable rail solutions while creating long-term opportunities for our clients and workforce.

We're a proud Tasmanian family-owned business with over a century of experience in general engineering. The Opportunity
We're on the lookout for skilled Boilermaker Welders to join our dynamic team. Our workshop operations cover a wide range of fabrication and welding tasks, from light to heavy work with steel, stainless steel and aluminium components. You'll work from engineering drawings and use equipment such as CNC plasma cutters, plate rolls, brake presses, bandsaws, and various welding techniques such as MIG, TIG and stick.

What You'll Do
Operate equipment such as plate rolls, rotators, bandsaws, presses and overhead cranes.
Use a variety of welding equipment including MIG, TIG, and stick.
Fabricate steel, aluminium, and stainless-steel components and assemblies.
Carryout repairs on plant and equipment.
Perform welding tasks that range from basic general-purpose applications to coded welding on quality-critical components and equipment.

Why Join Us?
At Saunders & Ward, we offer:
The option to work a 4-day week.
Excellent working conditions.
Stable employment with a well-established, family-owned company.
A diverse range of stimulating work.
Modern, well-organised and clean workshops.
A friendly, safety-focused culture.
Regular overtime.
A graded pay structure that rewards skills and experience.
Annual performance and wage reviews.
Rostered days off (RDOs).

What We're Looking For
To be successful in this role, you should have:
A strong commitment to safe work practices.
A fabrication trade qualification.
Engineering workshop experience.
Experience with mild steel MIG welding and fabrication.
The ability to complete jobs on time and to quality standards.
The ability to pass drug and alcohol screening.

Ezzi Building Services Pty Ltd is seeking suitably qualified and experienced applicants for the positions of Construction Project Manager and Project Builder in Perth, Western Australia. The successful applicant will be responsible for managing residential and/or commercial construction projects from planning through to completion, ensuring projects are delivered safely, on time, within budget and to a high standard of workmanship.

Responsibilities
The successful applicant will be responsible for overseeing construction projects, coordinating labour and subcontractors, liaising with clients, suppliers and consultants, and ensuring compliance with Australian building standards, workplace health and safety
requirements and company procedures.
The role requires strong project management capability, practical building knowledge and the ability to supervise works across multiple stages of construction.

Tasks
Key tasks include:
• Planning, coordinating and managing construction projects from commencement to completion.
• Preparing and reviewing project schedules and project plans, construction programs, budgets and work plans.
• Supervising site activities and coordinating trades, subcontractors and suppliers.
• Monitoring project progress, costs, materials, labour and quality of work.
• Interpreting plans, drawings, specifications and building documentation.
• Liaising with clients, architects, engineers, certifiers, local authorities and other stakeholders.
• Ensuring all work complies with relevant building codes, Australian standards, safety regulations and contractual requirements.
• Managing variations, delays, defects, site issues and project reporting.
• Conducting site inspections and ensuring quality control throughout the construction process.
• Maintaining accurate project records, reports, schedules and compliance documentation.

Skills
Applicants should have:
• Strong knowledge of construction methods, project delivery and site management.
• Excellent organisational, planning and time-management skills.
• Ability to manage budgets, timelines, subcontractors and construction resources.
• Sound understanding of workplace health and safety requirements.
• Ability to read and interpret construction drawings, plans and specifications.
• Strong communication and negotiation skills.
• Problem-solving ability and attention to detail.
• Ability to work independently and as part of a team.
• Proficiency with construction project management systems, scheduling tools and Microsoft Office or similar software.

Qualifications
Applicants must hold relevant qualifications in building, construction management, project management, civil construction, or a related field.
Relevant Australian or overseas qualifications may be considered, including a diploma, advanced diploma, bachelor degree or equivalent trade/background experience in the building and construction industry.

Experience
Applicants must have relevant experience in construction project management, building supervision or project delivery, if a bachelor's degree is present. If no degree, then at least 5 years of experience in the relevant industry.
Previous experience in residential, commercial or mixed-use construction projects will be highly regarded. Experience managing subcontractors, construction schedules, budgets, compliance requirements and client communications is essential.
Ezzi Building Services Pty Ltd is an equal opportunity employer and welcomes applications from suitably qualified candidates.

SALARY: AUD $80,000 TO $100,000 PER ANNUM
